Posti's english contract price list of 30.9.2024, https://www.posti.fi/mzj3zpe8qb7p/7s9AsOwmnECySlx35uEAFO/2554fda2bfcab7eb8d7ac9a0ee51dcae/posti-parcel-services-and-express-freight-contract-prices-20240930.pdf, prints identical Express Freight figures on its page 3 and supplies the english wording and the transport-unit dimensions

vat_status.source_wording: Hinnat on esitetty ilman arvonlisäveroa, ellei toisin mainita. Hintoihin lisätään laskutuksessa kulloinkin voimassa oleva arvonlisävero.
vat_status.note: page 1. english list wording: 'The tariffs and rates are quoted excluding VAT, unless otherwise stated. VAT valid at the time will be added to prices during invoicing.'

unit_basis.value: per transport unit (loose package, rolltainer or half pallet, pallet, furniture pallet), first unit and each next unit to the same address, by delivery zone 0-5; not weight-based within a unit's capacity
unit_basis.source_wording: Express-rahdin hinnoittelu perustuu kappaleisiin, kuljetusyksikön tyyppiin, vyöhykkeisiin sekä käytettyihin lisäpalveluihin.
unit_basis.note: page 1. english list wording: 'The pricing of Express Freight is based on the transport unit type, the size of the shipment lot, transport distance, and the additional service used.'

fuel_surcharge_treatment.source_wording: Kulloinkin voimassaoleva polttoainelisä veloitetaan erikseen. Voimassa oleva polttoainelisä löytyy osoitteesta posti.fi/polttoainelisa.
fuel_surcharge_treatment.note: page 1. english list wording: 'An applicable fuel surcharge will be charged separately.'

pickup_treatment.value: not included: prices run from a Posti outlet; a pick-up is a separate charge
pickup_treatment.source_wording: Ellei toisin mainita, hinnat sisältävät kuljetuksen postista vastaanottajalle tai luovutuspisteeseen. Lähetyksille voi tilata erillismaksusta noudon
pickup_treatment.note: page 1. separate pick-up of one transport unit is printed as 40,33 on page 6 of this list and as 40.35 in both the 30.9.2024 english list and the digital parcel price list; recorded as printed in each

delivery_zone_definition.note: the zone list is a link; zones 0-5 are not defined in the document

transport_unit_limits_as_printed_en_2024.Pallet: Maximum width 120 cm, Maximum length 100 cm, Maximum gross weight 1000 kg
transport_unit_limits_as_printed_en_2024.Half pallet: Maximum width 60 cm, Maximum length 80 cm, Maximum gross weight 500 kg
transport_unit_limits_as_printed_en_2024.Rolltainer: Maximum width 63 cm, Maximum length 81 cm, Maximum gross weight 250 kg
transport_unit_limits_as_printed_en_2024.Furniture pallet: Maximum width 80 cm, Maximum length 200 cm, Maximum gross weight 1200 kg
